title: Bihar Police Hawaldaar Exam Paper Leak Alleged, Biometric Supervisor Arrested
summary: A Bihar police officer allegedly leaked the exam paper for a junior post, and a biometric supervisor was arrested in connection with the incident. The Bihar Police Examination Organisation (EOU) claimed to have caught three suspects involved in the leak. The government said that the leak was an attempt to disrupt the recruitment process. The opposition alleged that the police were trying to suppress dissent by using the leaked paper.
summary_points: A Bihar police officer allegedly leaked the exam paper for a junior post.
